newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: TENNIS-SANCHEZ VICARIO CRASHES OUT OF AUSTRALIAN OPEN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-SANCHEZ VICARIO CRASHES OUT OF AUSTRALIAN OPEN.

text.p: World number three Arantxa Sanchez Vicario crashed out of the Australian Open in the third round on Saturday in her worst performance in a grand slam for five years.
The Spanish second seed was beaten by Belgian Dominique van Roost 1-6 6-4 8-6 on Centre Court in the biggest upset of the tournament to date.
Sanchez Vicario, a losing finalist in five of the last eight grand slam events, fell away badly to succumb to the unseeded Van Roost after winning the first set easily.
Van Roost, ranked 43 in the world and winner of a low-key warm-up event in Hobart last week, needed medical treatment on her right elbow before serving out the match in two hours and 14 minutes.
Sanchez Vicario, a finalist at Melbourne Park in 1994 and 1995 and three-time grand slam winner, could not find a reply to her slightly-built opponent's punishing ground strokes and deft net play.

Van Roost, who has never progressed beyond the fourth round at a grand slam event, will play either American 15th seed Chanda Rubin or qualifier Sandra Kleinova of the Czech Republic in the fourth round.
